sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's accelerating digital infrastructure buildout—fiber, data centers, and 5G—is a durable driver for local connectivity names like INET and WIFI, independent of US tech sentiment.
Government-led initiatives (national data center, e-government, and rural internet expansion) create recurring revenue visibility for domestic tech players, insulating them from global rate cycles.
The persistent valuation gap between Indonesian tech (cheap, local-demand driven) and US peers (expensive, macro-sensitive) supports rotation into ID-listed tech as a structural alpha source.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian tech names on local strength (INET, YELO, WIFI) while avoiding US-exposed laggards; the +1.02% ID vs -2.55% US divergence signals domestic catalysts (digital adoption, government connectivity push) outweigh global risk-off. Accumulate INET on momentum, add YELO for infrastructure exposure, and trim any US-heavy positions into strength.

sectors.ai: Buy BYAN on the coal price floor and domestic demand uptick; its +20% move signals institutional accumulation, but lock in partial gains above 25,000. Favor INDY and MYOH for thermal export leverage, avoid chasing ALKA's speculative spike. Position for Q3 earnings beats, trim into strength if IDX energy breadth fades below 1.30% aggregate gain.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's inter-island trade and commodity logistics demand remain structurally insulated from US slowdowns, supporting sustained domestic volume growth for port and shipping operators.
Consolidation in port and warehouse assets, plus tariff adjustments, is driving margin expansion for mid-cap logistics names like KJEN and SOCI, a durable earnings driver.
Government infrastructure spending on ports and toll roads continues to lower distribution costs, structurally improving profitability for integrated logistics players over multi-year horizons.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics selectively on domestic volume recovery, not broad beta: KJEN, PORT, and SOCI lead on port/warehouse throughput and tariff repricing, while TMAS and RMKE offer coastal bulk upside. Trim US-exposed names if global trade slows; hold core positions through Q3 as IDX logistics outperformance persists on resilient inter-island demand.
